pages.text: Spellcasting takes time in most cases, but on adventures you'll always encounter emergencies where there's no time to cast, filling you with deep anxiety.$(br)Fortunately, these records of flesh magic and machinery gave you an idea: why not embed foci directly into the body? And so the Flesh Casket was born.$(br)Foci placed inside a Casket will auto-cast when the wearer takes damage, and do not share cooldowns with other foci of the same type.

The Casket has three versions, each with different trigger conditions:$(br)$(l:goetymech_focuses/flesh_casket)Fullness$(): casts on any damage taken.$(br)$(l:goetymech_focuses/flesh_casket)Balance$(): casts only when health is below half.$(br)$(l:goetymech_focuses/flesh_casket)Deathbed$(): casts only when health is below 20%%.$(br)Place the Casket into a Cursed Infuser to cycle between conditions.$(br)$(4)"A good start, but human flesh is ultimately too fragile to bear too many foci. Perhaps becoming a lich could solve this."$()
